title: GgenIgniter refusal vocabulary
description: Enumerated machine-readable set of every typed refusal code emitted in lib/. Canonical text form: REFUSED:<CODE> <detail>. Legacy forms REFUSED(code) subject: detail and REFUSED_<CODE> detail parse to the same code. The top-level `refusals` array is the registry; GgenIgniter.Refusals reads it at compile time.

Repair the graph facts listed by gates/000_violations.rq; a malformed surface renders nothing.

Fix the CS2 batch document: it must be a map with one shared subject/repository/base_sha/source_digest, unique non-empty work identities, and acyclic dependencies (see the wrapped reasons).

Rebuild the descriptor from an admitted work order: fix the invalid provider option, identity_mismatch, snapshot_drift, or admit the work order (unadmitted) and retry.

DO needs an admitted origin (a refused_origin reason means fix the authority), an available claim store (claim_store_unavailable), and a matching precondition (missing_or_mismatched_precondition); DO flows only through BRCE.

Fix the doctrine-admission input named by the boundary in the reason (source_identity, scope_guard, replay, evidence, method, etc.): supply the exact subject or the digest/standing/authority it names.

Remove the duplicate work order.
Fix the architecture input the wrapped reason names: DO authority is forbidden, requested authority may not exceed the origin, SBB must be qualified, and ABB/contract digests must match.
Attest only an alive receipt with a post_run_hash equal to the re-hashed files and a matching graph_hash and receipt_hash; re-run the manufacture to refresh them.
Supply every required option with valid digests and resolved dependencies, and follow the allowed status transitions (verify before retire).
Run inside a git work tree, pass a base_dir that contains every judged file, and record the watermark first (mix ggen_igniter.epoch.watermark) so watermark_not_found clears.
The epoch declaration disagrees with the invariants the epoch requires; the reason maps each key to expected and observed, so correct those keys.
Plan fresh manufacture, not an edit of a path present in the watermark.

Name only post-watermark artifacts in the plan.
Attribute the planned implementation path to a generator or residue admission.
Run in a git work tree over a non-empty implementation set; restamp_required means a watermark already exists for the epoch and must be re-stamped deliberately.
Run mix ggen_igniter.epoch.watermark and pass --epoch-manifest.
Repair the rx:Extension graph reported by gates/000_violations.rq (sections, entities, transformer order, defaults).
The admitted file must exist on disk; create it first.
Remove the forbidden input (e.g. path outside allowed roles).

Do not edit goal nodes past admission.

Restore the gate script the ontology names.

Fix the resilience profile: map-shaped, two distinct generations with valid ids and digests, all required fields, and known techniques with map policies.
Fill the missing sj: predicate on the root GoalCheckpoint.
Provide exactly one root GoalCheckpoint.
Declare exactly one sm:initialState naming a declared state of the machine.
Repair the malformed input document.

Give the ii:Dep a name, requirement, mode and order.
Supply every fact the ii:Installer template needs (module, task name, deps).

Repair the ledger the bootstrap refused.

Unset LLM credentials in the environment; bootstrap must be deterministic.

Existing output differs from recomputed bytes; regenerate.

Pass an existing --pack-ontology path.

A pack gate contract failed under mix ggen_igniter.verify; run it without --json-envelope to see which gate query violated its cardinality contract and fix the pack ontology or query.
A rendered output resolves outside the project root; use a relative out-template that stays within the root.

Supply a portable sa2a.semantic-evidence-envelope.v1 with an absolute exact-subject URN or https IRI, non-empty canonical fields and no authority-bearing claims; the envelope is evidence only and never grants standing.

project_standing takes a list of admitted transition events; repair the event named in the reason so standing re-derives.
Give the non-terminal state an outgoing sm:Transition, or mark it sm:terminal true.
Add a transition into the named state from a reachable state, or remove the unreachable sm:State.
No free subject IRI after 200 attempts; pick another base.
refusals.not_applicable_reason: IRI allocation ran out of free subjects after 200 attempts; a resource limit, not a broken term of the receipt equation.

Present a genuine intent: its transition_digest must re-derive (intent_digest_mismatch), its from must equal the current standing (stale_intent) and bind the work-order digest (intent_not_bound_to_work_order).
Declare the from/to/initial state as an sm:State of the same machine, or correct the transition's state name.
Admit the file with mix ggen_igniter.hand_authored.
Cover every gate of the root with at least one proposition.
Regenerate, or admit fresh residue that differs below the similarity threshold.
--kind must name an admitted HandAuthoredKind.

Give the ii:Upgrader an installer, a version and a module.
Use a known ii:Step kind and supply the facts that kind needs.
Downgrades are refused; pass a higher --to version.
Pass a valid version.
Fix the command-line arguments.
refusals.not_applicable_reason: A command-line argument error is a caller mistake before any observation exists; no term of A=mu(O*) is broken.
